title: Build a budget that works for you
summary: Compare take-home income with spending and debt obligations before deciding how much to save.

title: How much emergency savings do you need?
summary: Accessible savings can cushion unexpected costs. A reserve covering several months of expenses is a common starting point; individual needs vary.

title: Debt action plan
summary: After covering minimum payments, directing extra payments toward the highest interest rate can reduce interest costs. Different repayment strategies have different tradeoffs.

title: Matching contributions help you save
summary: Employer matching depends on the plan's contribution formula and eligibility. Confirm costs, vesting, and limits with your plan administrator.

title: Grow your savings
summary: Define a goal and a contribution you can afford. Regular saving can help you make steady progress.

title: Create your investment strategy
summary: Investment choices depend on your goals, time horizon, and ability to take risk. Potential returns are uncertain.
